- **Clients: invoices, deposits and online payment (FL-1081, FL-1041, FL-1037):** connect your studio's payment account through Frameleaf Cloud, send invoices with a deposit, and let clients pay online from a payment link. Unpaid invoices get reminders.
- **Clients: contracts you can sign online (FL-1076, FL-1079):** make contract templates, send a contract, and your client signs it on a signing page. No outside signing service is needed.
- **Clients: booking types (FL-1049, FL-1053, FL-1567):** set up the sessions you offer with a length, price, deposit and paid add-ons. Your studio website gets a "Book a session" button with a live total, and booking contacts can be included in email campaigns.
- **Guest selfie search runs on your computer or Frameleaf Cloud (FL-1058):** a guest's selfie can be matched on the photographer's Desktop helper, or on Frameleaf Cloud when face recognition is set to use it.
- **Caption several clips on Frameleaf Cloud (FL-1429):** select several clips and caption them together. Each clip shows its own price and is confirmed on its own.
- **Best Photos learns what looks good (FL-978):** Best Photos uses a learned beauty score from visual search, so its picks are better.
- **Faster thumbnails and albums (FL-1595, FL-1596):** thumbnails you've already seen show at once without asking the server again, and albums open straight away and then refresh.
- **Faster timeline on large libraries (FL-820, FL-1592):** only the months that changed are worked out again, so the timeline stays quick on libraries with millions of photos.
- **Uploads go ahead of imports (FL-1603):** a photo uploaded from your phone or computer no longer waits behind a large folder scan or import. Bulk edits retry once by themselves if something goes wrong, and old read notifications are cleared.
- **Background work is steadier (FL-1600, FL-1601, FL-1602, FL-1590, FL-1591, FL-1598):** paused jobs stay paused after a retry, queues take turns, duplicate work is skipped, and work recovers on its own after a problem. Finding look-alikes no longer holds up changes to the rest of your library. Buddy Backup locks your library for moments instead of minutes and picks up where it left off after its backup window ends. A large folder's first scan no longer fails partway, a stuck worker restarts by itself, and removing a face while it is being recognised no longer fails.
- **Setup on a reinstalled server (FL-1589):** setup starts at the admin form instead of skipping past it.
- **Frameleaf Connect (FL-1514, FL-1517, FL-1519, FL-1520, FL-1521, FL-1522, FL-1580):** Connect gets limited-access grants, file transfers and events, and new apps: n8n, Make, Zapier, Raycast and Obsidian. Connect checks your library's identity before sending a sign-in token.
- **Lightroom Classic (FL-982):** publish Lightroom Classic collections to Frameleaf albums.
- **Manager on HexOS (FL-1111):** Manager can use another port when 2282 is taken.
